site.heroSubtext: Leafcut is a lean video studio for startups and brands. We turn ideas into explainer videos, product demos and social content built with structure, emotion and intent.
site.aboutHeading: A small studio, built for clear, honest storytelling.
site.aboutPara1: We help businesses turn ideas into clear, engaging videos that people understand, feel and respond to — not just watch. Our team has produced thousands of videos for startups, agencies and brands across SaaS, eCommerce and service businesses.
site.aboutPara2: Every project runs through the same process: a clear brief, a tight script, considered visuals, and a final cut built for the platform it's meant to live on. No bloated timelines, no jargon — just video that does its job.
site.testimonialQuote: Leafcut understood our vision from the first call and turned it into something we're proud to put in front of customers. Fast, clear, and genuinely creative.
